title: Interaction Designer — Cobalt Retail Group
text:
About
Cobalt Retail Group is an omnichannel retailer with 300 stores and a fast-growing online business. We are looking for an Interaction Designer to deliver the highest quality user experience across our mobile and web applications, connecting our in-store and digital customer journeys. This is a full-time, on-location position. Please no recruiters. You will join the UX Team and specialize in front-end development prototyping, reporting to the Chief Experience Officer while working with the entire team. You are opinionated and enthusiastic about user experience and technology, and you see HTML, CSS and JavaScript as your paintbrushes. You are excited about prototyping product features, apps and tools, you are compelled to simplify things that are too complicated, and you take pride in clean, efficient code. Salary is commensurate with capabilities and experience.

Responsibilities
Design and deliver high-quality user experiences for mobile and web applications. Prototype product features, apps and tools using front-end technologies. Write, reverse engineer, replicate, recombine and invent front-end code solutions that balance speed of delivery with strong performance. Simplify complex interfaces and workflows so they are easy to use. Collaborate with the entire team using shared development and project tools. Report to the Chief Experience Officer and work closely with the UX Team. Stay aware of emerging trends in front-end web development and design.

Requirements
Expertise in current full-stack web development technologies (HTML5, CSS, jQuery, Sass, etc.). At least 4 years of relevant work experience, including demonstrated experience designing usable web-based interfaces. Strong visual and interactive design skills, with a clear grasp of typography, layout, color, motion and behavior. Familiarity with collaborative tools (GitHub, StackOverflow, JIRA, Confluence, etc.). Ability to write, reverse engineer, replicate, recombine, invent and hack front-end code solutions that balance speed of delivery with bulletproof performance. Links to active GitHub and/or StackOverflow profiles (please share links). Awareness of emerging trends in front-end web development and design.

Benefits
Full health benefits. Salary commensurate with capabilities and experience.

title: Creative UX/UI Director — Ridgeway Manufacturing
text:
About
Ridgeway Manufacturing is an industrial manufacturer of precision components for the energy and transport sectors. As we expand our digital offerings, including customer portals, configuration and ordering tools, equipment monitoring dashboards and mobile applications for field and plant teams, we are looking for a Creative UX/UI Director to lead the design of engaging, user-centered experiences. The ideal candidate thrives in an environment that demands strong problem solving and independent self-direction, paired with a talent for team collaboration and open communication. You will build and develop an award-winning design team that delivers both highly analytical and highly creative ideas to every design engagement, and you will have extensive experience in a fast-paced, innovative development environment. A thorough understanding of contemporary user-centered design methodologies is a must.

Responsibilities
Build, lead and develop a design team that delivers both analytical and creative design work. Execute interaction design and visual design as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Collaborate on user experience planning with a senior application architect. Consult with internal stakeholders, clients and the senior application architect. Research interaction design trends and technology trends. Act as spokesperson and evangelist for all UX/UI-related matters across the company. Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements
Five or more years of user experience design experience for software, web applications that leverage emergent technologies, consumer electronics and/or mobile devices. Strong conceptualization and visual communication ability, including drawing skills and sketchbook technique. Exceptional design skills, production value and attention to detail. Ability to create wireframes as well as visual design comps. Strong working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Fireworks and associated design tools. Experience with user interface design patterns and standard user-centered design methodologies. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Understanding of common software project management and software development practices. Experience with Adobe Premiere, After Effects, rendering and animation. Motion graphics design and production, and video and sound editing. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, Rails, JavaScript/jQuery, Objective-C (iOS) and C++ (Android) is a plus. Bachelor's or Master's degree in interaction design, new media design or a related design field. Some travel is required. A portfolio must accompany your resume. Background and reference checks are required upon hire.

Benefits
Employees have the option to join the company's private medical scheme, and may include family members in the scheme at the employee's own expense. Vacation time is at the discretion of the employee's manager, and vacation is paid only when approved by the manager.

title: Apparel / Streetwear Designer — Brightpath Health
text:
About
Brightpath Health is a digital health company building apps that help patients follow their treatment plans. As part of a new initiative, we are creating a line of functional, made-in-the-US men's and women's apparel, such as t-shirts and hoodies, that supports our patient engagement efforts. We have a tested concept and detailed prototypes, and now we need a designer to help turn the concept into a finished product line. This is a temporary and/or part-time role.

Responsibilities
Spec out the materials, designs and patterns needed to bring the apparel line from concept to production. Work from our existing detailed prototypes to finalize designs for t-shirts, hoodies and similar garments. Solve the embroidery and design challenges included in the line. Create wearable prototypes. Coordinate with manufacturers as needed throughout the process. The first project is estimated at two weeks of full-time work spread over roughly one month.

Requirements
Experience designing streetwear, with a portfolio to show it. Ability to create wearable prototypes. Understanding of a range of materials, from basic t-shirt garments to hook-and-loop attachments. Ability to coordinate with manufacturers as needed.

Benefits
Flexibility and the ability to set your own hours. Potential for continued work after the initial project. Potential to structure compensation to include royalties, if desired.

title: Creative Director / Design Director — Brightpath Health
text:
About
Brightpath Health is a digital health company building apps that help patients follow their treatment plans. We believe design and development are inextricably linked, and that great design can simplify people's lives and improve health outcomes. We are looking for a Design Director ready to break new ground and lead our creative team at the forefront of digital health.

Responsibilities
Lead our creative team and oversee all design and user experience efforts across our products and partner projects. Provide inspired creative direction to guide a team of five designers, while keeping the overall picture and business goals in view. Act as Creative Lead across multiple products and varied projects, understanding brand and business strategy and balancing strategic requirements with inspirational work. Benefits
Work in a fast-paced creative environment that is growing rapidly. Learn first-hand how to start, grow and market new products. Build apps that thousands of people will use and love. Team lunches, drinks and social events. Flexible holidays. Quarterly bonus scheme based on on-target earnings.

title: Product Visual Designer — Harbor & Finch Financial
text:
About

We are building clear, user-friendly digital tools that help our clients and advisors manage complex financial information with confidence. We are seeking an experienced Visual Designer to work closely with colleagues across the firm to create compelling, efficient visual designs for our client-facing and internal digital products.

Competitive salary and performance-based incentive compensation. Flexible vacation policy. Fully employer-paid premiums for medical, dental, vision and life insurance. Workstation setup of your choice. Complimentary snacks and beverages. Regular team and family events.

title: Human Centered Industrial Designer — Ridgeway Manufacturing
text:
About
Ridgeway Manufacturing is an industrial manufacturer of precision components for the energy and transport sectors. We are building a design capability that puts the people who install, operate, and maintain our products at the center of how we develop them. As a Human Centered Industrial Designer, you will work with engineering, manufacturing, and commercial teams to reimagine our components, assemblies, and related user experiences, taking concepts from early research through to production-ready designs.

Responsibilities
Apply design-thinking and industrial design methods to reimagine human-centered products, services, and user experiences through collaborative problem solving with a multidisciplinary team. Serve as a key contributor and/or appointed lead on primary and secondary research, trend analysis, conceptual ideation, 2-D/3-D concept development, material selection, and tech pack creation. Contribute to our thought leadership in user-centered design approaches and innovation best practices. Navigate multidisciplinary input and constructive critique so that products balance compelling visual design with a great user experience. Manage projects from concept to completion, including rapid prototyping, vendor management, and communication with engineering, manufacturing, and sourcing partners.

Requirements
Undergraduate degree in Product Design, Industrial Design, or an equivalent visual design discipline; a master's degree is preferred. 2-5+ years of experience in product or industrial design for mid-level roles; 5-10+ years for design lead roles. Deep knowledge of visual theory, branding, color theory, materials, finishes, sustainability analysis, and product construction techniques. An online/digital portfolio demonstrating strong user-centered design work across a diverse range of projects. Expert skills in 2-D analog visual communication, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), 3-D analog prototyping, 3-D modeling (e.g., SolidWorks), and rapid prototyping procurement. Ability to execute a project from concept to completion, drawing on investigative research, ideation, concept development, engineering collaboration, rapid prototyping, and vendor management. Strong interpersonal and communication skills; self-motivated, takes initiative, and offers suggestions for improvement. Diligence, attention to detail, and technical intuition. A flexible, positive team player able to solve problems with a multidisciplinary team, handle competing priorities, and stay composed in a fast-paced environment. Sound judgment and trustworthiness in handling confidential information. Experience working within a complex matrix organization, including managing complex reporting relationships and working across multiple cultures and labor regulations.

Benefits
Ridgeway Manufacturing offers a collaborative, engineering-led environment where design has a real influence on products used in critical energy and transport applications. We value integrity, respect for the individual, delivering value to our customers, and making a positive impact. Employees benefit from opportunities for professional growth, exposure to a broad range of projects, and the chance to work with experienced colleagues across design, engineering, and manufacturing.

title: Graphic Designer — Brightpath Health
text:
About
Brightpath Health is a digital health company building apps that help patients follow their treatment plans. We are looking for a talented graphic designer to join our small, creative team in Atlanta. Design web and mobile user interfaces and visual assets for our patient-facing apps and related web experiences. Apply strong typographic judgment, including a well-reasoned point of view on typefaces and typographic detail, to create clear and polished designs. Collaborate with a small, cross-functional team of designers and technologists to bring ideas from concept to finished product. Manage your own workload and deliver work on schedule while continually growing and developing as a designer.

Proven experience in graphic design with a focus on web and UI design. Deep knowledge of typography and the ability to articulate design choices, such as the differences between similar typefaces. title: Communication / Brand Designer — Brightpath Health
text:
About
Brightpath Health is a digital health company building apps that help patients follow their treatment plans. Our products support patients and care teams with clear, engaging experiences that make staying on track easier. We are looking for a hands-on design expert who is a strategic, creative thinker with a strong portfolio and a passion for designing beautiful, unique, and thoughtful work. As part of the core team, you will bring a collaborative working style, great communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

Responsibilities
Lead strategic branding and communication efforts. Develop brand deliverables that enable market-specific content and design. Work cross-functionally with business leads (business, sales, marketing, product and partnerships) to scope, manage, and produce brand deliverables that drive strategic acquisition efforts. Help build a brand and marketing team. Identify and collaborate with third-party creative agencies to create brand deliverables. Produce and implement design and production assets in a timely manner. Examples by team: Communications: company website and social media channels. Sales: sales material in print and web. Marketing: testimonial videos, team videos, event invitations, email marketing, and client-focused one-pagers. Brand: develop brand material and guidelines. Plan and manage the production schedule independently, through creative agencies, with third-party vendors, and with copywriters. Ensure consistent use of brand and messaging across all content and channels.

Requirements
Experience in an agency, design studio, or creative consultancy. A self-directed work style with a high comfort level in ambiguous environments. Strong ability to work across different media. A strong portfolio and an elevated sense of design, photography, and typography; you know the difference between good and great, and can work through team dynamics, time zones, and timelines to deliver excellent, strategically driven design solutions at all levels. Communication skills: strong verbal and visual presentation skills, a clear point of view, and an understanding of the value of design within a business, platform, and vertical context. Team skills: you work best in a participatory, team-based environment and support and inspire teams through collaboration as well as direction, vision, and planning of all aspects of creative deliverables. Openness: flexible, open-minded, optimistic, generative, and open to new ideas and ways of working. Prototyping skills: you learn from failure and embrace an iterative process, with experience creating both low- and high-fidelity design deliverables for print and screen.

Benefits
Health insurance. Flexible time off policy and a genuine commitment to work/life balance. Stocked fridge, snacks, and good coffee. Great location. Support for professional development. Competitive salary. Smart, passionate, and kind colleagues.

title: Front-End Web Designer — Lumen Studio Collective
text:
About
Lumen Studio Collective is a design and brand studio working with consumer and cultural brands. We are a collaborative, flexible and supportive team that values craft, clarity and results. Our people work across multiple locations in a remote-friendly environment that gives real freedom to those who deliver, and relocation is not required.

Generous paid time off.

title: Mobile App Designer — Harbor & Finch Financial

title: Accounting Office Associate — Cobalt Retail Group
text:
About
Cobalt Retail Group is an omnichannel retailer with 300 stores and a fast-growing online business. We are building a team of driven professionals in a culture built on constant personal and professional growth. We hold each other accountable, challenge drama, entitlement and gossip, and reward enthusiasm, integrity and teamwork. Managers take responsibility for daily training and coaching, and every team member takes responsibility for learning new things and improving their skills. We value positive energy, integrity, honesty, compassion, loyalty, a strong sense of team, and a desire to delight both coworkers and customers. We look for high standards, enthusiasm, and a drive to keep improving and reach the next level. We do not value entitlement, drama, gossip, or unreliability. This is a full-time position.

Responsibilities
Cash out customers across sales, service and parts transactions. Prepare the daily deposit and reconcile the appropriate accounts. Keep schedules clean and up to date. Pull keys and books for the sales department. Maintain the sublet schedule. Process W-9s and 1099s. Assist with monthly closings. Prepare analysis of accounts as required. Maintain an organized filing system. Process title work. Perform other duties assigned by management.

Requirements
Prior dealership or comparable retail accounting office experience is required. Ability to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner. Excellent customer service skills. Accuracy and thoroughness, with the ability to monitor quality, meet productivity standards and complete work on time. Dependable, punctual and consistent attendance, and able to follow management instruction. Well organized, able to multi-task, detail oriented and a strong team player.

Benefits
Full-time position with a full benefits package. A culture of ongoing training, coaching and professional growth, with daily support from managers.

title: Accounting Assistant — Ridgeway Manufacturing
text:
About

Hourly pay of $16.00-$17.00 per hour. 1-year temporary position.

title: Accounting Clerk – Transaction Funding & Settlement — Northwind Logistics
text:

- Basic life insurance and a pension/retirement plan with employer matching contributions
- Employee discounts on company products and services
- Paid time off
- Supplemental benefit plans including dental coverage, short-term and long-term disability, supplemental life insurance and legal services

title: Accounts Payable Administrator — Northwind Logistics
text:

title: Director of Finance — Cobalt Retail Group
text:
About
Cobalt Retail Group is an omnichannel retailer with 300 stores and a fast-growing online business. We are hiring a Director of Finance to join our team of high-performing professionals and lead the financial and accounting function as we continue to scale across store and digital channels.

Responsibilities
Plan and manage all finance and accounting operations, including periodic financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow), financial reporting, general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll, cash and expense management, human resources, and the forecasting, planning and use of resources (capital, people, technology). Use financial statements and other information sources to communicate financial results through reports, verbal communication and dashboards, identify trends, and determine areas for cost reduction and improvement. Serve as liaison between the company and banks or financing partners, and create reporting protocols to share financial performance information with them. Implement short-term and long-term financial objectives and the corresponding policies and procedures in collaboration with the Director of Operations and other partners. Work with the UK office to streamline existing accounting functions and redirect work to the US office where it creates efficiencies across both offices. Determine reasonable credit limits and terms for customers and ensure the accuracy of customer information in the ERP system. Manage royalty reporting and tracking, act as liaison with licensor contacts, and ensure royalty reporting protocols are communicated and consistently applied across the company. Incorporate sales forecasts into financial plans, goals and objectives. Prepare, coordinate and/or assist with year-end tax returns as required. Adhere to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) in all financial and accounting practices. Set and communicate performance standards and expectations; coach, guide and motivate staff; monitor performance and provide regular feedback, development and evaluation. Recruit and hire staff, assign duties, and review and approve work schedules. Build constructive relationships with staff at all levels and with third parties such as suppliers, distribution channels, financial institutions and customers, using strong negotiation skills to resolve issues. Take on various projects and other duties as requested or required.

Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA strongly preferred. Experience with and familiarity with UK accounting rules is a significant plus. Fifteen years of experience in increasingly responsible management roles in accounting and finance. A minimum of ten years of experience managing and developing employees in a high-performance work culture. High-level skills in using financial and accounting statements and reports, operations performance data and other information resources for management analysis, evaluation and decision-making. High-level knowledge of technology platforms for financial information management, sales and customer relationship management (CRM). High-level skills in managing financial resources, forecasting, budgeting and planning. Very strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and advanced reporting capabilities. Very strong critical thinking and logical reasoning skills. Excellent organizational, time management and project management skills. Excellent problem identification and solutions-based problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple competing priorities daily. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Benefits

title: CFO Co-Founder (Finance Lead, Venture Initiative) — Harbor & Finch Financial
text:
About
Harbor & Finch Financial is a mid-sized wealth and corporate finance advisory firm based in London, UK. We are seeking a finance co-founder to join an early-stage venture we are building: a peer-to-peer and designer rental marketplace for fashion. The venture lets members rent items from one another and monetize their wardrobes. It gives designers a market research tool and a customer acquisition channel, since members can buy after renting. Responsibilities
Act as finance co-founder and lead the financial strategy of the venture. Carry out business and financial analysis to guide key decisions. Review and benchmark business plans against comparable companies. Build and maintain cash flow forecasts. Develop detailed business plan financial models. Perform valuation work to support fundraising and strategic planning. Work closely with the other co-founders as the platform and mobile app move towards launch.

Requirements
Rigorous and analytical profile. Demonstrated experience in business and financial analysis, business plan review and benchmarking, cash flow forecasting, business plan modeling and valuation. Comfort working in a fast-moving, lean startup environment and taking on co-founder level responsibility.

Benefits
Compensation based on equity.

title: Recovery Specialist — Cobalt Retail Group
text:
About
Cobalt Retail Group is an omnichannel retailer with 300 stores and a fast-growing online business. Our customer credit and accounts team supports shoppers who use our store credit and financing programs. We are growing this team of high-performing professionals and are hiring a full-time Recovery Specialist to join our collaborative, team-oriented environment.

Responsibilities
Independently work assigned accounts to locate customers and/or collateral by performing advanced loss prevention activities. Perform basic and advanced skip-tracing using internal and external skip-tracing resources. Negotiate account resolution and accurately enter and document all actions in the collections system. Monitor and measure the performance of third-party repossession agents and other outside vendors to ensure goals are met in the most cost-effective manner. Ensure all company policies and procedures are followed. Alert management to potential risk exposure. Schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, with the ability to work Saturdays and late evenings as needed.

Requirements

title: Assistant Service Manager — Brightpath Health
text:

title: Sales Representative — Harbor & Finch Financial
text:
About

title: Inside Sales Representative — Ridgeway Manufacturing
text:

title: Front Desk Clerk — Ridgeway Manufacturing
text:
About
Ridgeway Manufacturing is an industrial manufacturer of precision components for the energy and transport sectors. Our front desk is the first point of contact for visitors, suppliers, drivers and callers, and we are looking for an entry-level Front Desk Clerk who is courteous, organized and dependable to represent the company at our main reception.

Responsibilities
Greet and direct visitors, customers, co-workers and contractors in a courteous and friendly manner every day. Answer phones and questions, and provide accurate information clearly and concisely in line with company policies. Receive inbound deliveries, returns and drop-offs, and complete all required paperwork at the time of receipt. Enter all receiving and intake information into the company management system accurately and on time. Process cash, check and credit card payments as well as other payments received at the desk. High school diploma or equivalent. At least 6 months of prior customer service experience, including answering phones and handling money. Working knowledge of Microsoft products and comfort with computers. Experience with office equipment such as calculators, credit card machines, computers and printers. Ability to communicate with the public in a professional, positive and courteous manner and to communicate clearly and effectively in English. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Ability to handle stressful situations with good problem-solving and interpersonal skills. Ability to work cooperatively with a diverse group of people. Ability to handle difficult or aggressive individuals and situations calmly and safely. General knowledge of the company's departments and their functions, or willingness to learn quickly. Up-to-date safety and health records as required for site access.

Benefits
Vacation, sick leave and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision insurance. Life insurance. 401(k) plan. Pension plan. Company events. Employee discounts.

- Strong production software engineering in Python and FastAPI.
